text:
Asha (Events): FYI we got a corner table at East Bay DevMixer on May 3. Foot traffic expected ~120. We have a 20-min lightning demo at 2:10. Need decisions: demo flow, swag mix, speaker bio + headshot for the roster.
Liam - Marketing: I'll handle bio/headshot. What do we want to lead with — product demo (latency/cost) or a how-to (integrate Redwood API)?
Noah - Growth: Lean into a how-to focused on integrations — most attendees are engineers. Include a micro-benchmark slide (one stat + link to longer report) and a CTA to sign up for the follow-up webinar.
Ruth (Design): Swag mockups ready. Options: 120 stickers (roll), 80 tees (unisex S-XL), 100 silicon phone pockets, 60 enamel pins. Any changes?
Zoe - Ops: Shipping note 0 tee sizes hard to predict. Recommend 90 shirts + stickers 120 + phone pockets 80 + pins 60. Courier pickup window is May 3 16:00-17:00 at venue.
Asha (Events): Ok lock shirts 90. Ruth can you finalize artwork and send print-ready files by Apr 18?
Ruth (Design): Yep. Using the new minimal logo layout. I'll export as PDF + SVG and drop in Drive /Marketing/Events/EastBay/Assets by Apr 16.
Liam - Marketing: Webinar follow-up date proposal: May 17 (two weeks after). Short webinar on "Fast inference at scale" with live Q&A. Noah will we auto-invite QR leads?
Noah - Growth: Yes. QR at the booth -> short form -> add to HubSpot. Workflow: form submit -> assign lead score + if score >=25 then send webinar invite + tag "eastbay_mixer". I'll create the workflow. Use UTMs: utm_source=eastbay_mixer&utm_campaign=may_push&utm_medium=qr.
registrations-bot: New event registration: 37 RSVPs via Meetup. Link: https://meetup.com/example (auto-post).
Asha (Events): Demo needs: 4k monitor, HDMI adapter, power distro, portable router (venue wifi flaky), and a small lockbox. Anyone can bring a router?
Zoe - Ops: I have a travel router we can borrow. I'll pack power strip and an adaptor. Also booking FastShip pickup for May 3 16:30. Label below: 
```
Ship to: East Bay Community Hall
Attn: Redwood Inference - Asha
Event date: May 3
Do not deliver before May 3 08:00
Pickup window: May 3 16:00-17:00
```
Liam - Marketing: Speaker slides deadline: Apr 24 EOD. Rehearsal slot Apr 29 (virtual 30 min). Please follow the Redwood event slide kit v4 (Drive link in #docs).
Ruth (Design): I'll prepare a 2-slide micro-bench: 1) tokens/sec vs instance type (visual), 2) cost-per-1k-tokens one-liner + source link.
Noah - Growth: For lead capture, add hidden field 'product_interest' with values [API, Dedicated, Private]. Also add an explicit checkbox: "Invite me to the follow-up webinar" (opt-in).
Asha (Events): Day-of roles: Liam = emcee/demo lead, Noah = lead capture & QR support, Zoe = logistics/courier. I'll run check-in.
Liam - Marketing: Post-event cadence: Day0 thank-you + slides + survey, Day4 webinar invite to opt-ins, Day9 SDR outreach to scored leads. Noah will draft HubSpot sequences.
Noah - Growth: Drafting sequences now. Also recommend a 10% discount code for attendees who sign up within 7 days (code: EBMIX10) to measure conversion.
Ruth (Design): Heads up on sticker trade: exchange sticker for email capture? We should avoid forced sign-ups. Recommend optional sticker + QR to sign up for pin raffle.
Zoe - Ops: Pin raffle sounds good and reduces friction. I'll prepare a raffle box and printed tickets.
Asha (Events): Quick checklist recap: Ruth finalize art (Apr 16), Liam slides (Apr 24), Zoe courier + router (Apr 28), Noah HubSpot workflow & UTMs (Apr 22). Rehearsal Apr 29.
Liam - Marketing: Adding to calendar now. Who's bringing backup demo environment?
Noah - Growth: I'll image a micro-SSD with the demo and bring it. Will add README with commands: `./start_demo.sh --offline` and `curl -X POST localhost:8000/health`.
Asha (Events): Thanks. We'll keep this thread for live day-of updates. Short 20-min sync tomorrow to confirm roles.
Liam - Marketing: :raised_hands: Good plan.
